candidates.name: Grid InQuest II transformation software
verified_facts: Grid InQuest II applies OSTN15 and OSGM15 for transformation between ETRS89 and OS National Grid/height systems.
It supports single-point and batch transformations and can operate offline.
OSTN15/OSGM15 replaced the older transformation models in August 2016.
semantic_limits: Use of the correct transformation software preserves reference-system lineage but does not prove sensor, raster or parcel-sampling accuracy by itself.

candidates.name: OSGM15 - the geoid for Britain
verified_facts: Ordnance Survey explains that GNSS-derived ellipsoidal heights and mean-sea-level-based heights are different quantities.
A geoid model supplies the relationship needed to derive national-datum heights from GNSS positioning.
OSGM15 is part of Britain's modern geodetic transformation framework.
semantic_limits: Geoid-model explanation or correction alone is not a parcel height observation and cannot cancel LiDAR, GNSS, antenna or sampling errors.
